body:
2026-06-09. I am working on a shared capture helper, stop hook, and stable MCP launcher. The purpose is to make the platform more dependable in actual use, with evidence that can be inspected rather than an assumption that a feature is complete.

What this changes

The implementation records a specific operating path and makes its controls visible. It creates a basis for later testing, correction, and review instead of treating the initial change as a final result.

Historical basis: 2026-06-09 repository milestone, commit 94ec996, 88bb67a.
